import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Select the Android template by filtering the radio button based on the associated link with the specific URL
    android_template_radio = page.get_by_role('radio', name='Use template').filter(
        has=page.get_by_role('link', name='Preview', exact=True).and_(page.get_by_role('link', url='https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/project-templates/android'))
    )
    await android_template_radio.click()
    # Wait for the UI to update after template selection
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
